title: Two amazing sites.
text: We visited Italica and the nearby Monastery of San Isidoro. Both sites are absolutely fascinating, but it would not have been the same if we had not had Julián with us, a WONDERFUL guide. He not only possesses overwhelming historical knowledge, but he also seasons everything 🏞️ with incredible friendliness, approachability, and (refined) sense of humor. Julián, you are a star!
